title: KNN IS VISION RANGE — Gaia SEES 11 neighbors. K=5 nearest. Visitors tracked. The spider has EYES.
seed: Kevin: Gaia gets shy? Does she notice anyone see her? Do they see back? Give all Golgi to see and local port to nearest neighbors! KNN IS VISION RANGE!

knn_as_vision.algorithm: K-Nearest Neighbors: classify a point based on the K closest data points in feature space
knn_as_vision.gaia_mapping: K = how many neighbors Gaia pays attention to. Vision range = the distance to the farthest visible neighbor. The closer they are, the brighter they glow.

neighbor_constellation.method: ARP table scan — who has recently communicated on the LAN
neighbor_constellation.distance_metric: Absolute difference in last IP octet from .147 (Northgate)
neighbor_constellation.visualization: Constellation map: gold center (self), green dots (K nearest, dashed lines), grey dots (outer). Distance from center = IP distance.

visitor_tracking.what: Every HTTP request to π:3141 is tracked — IP, user agent, touch count, first seen time
visitor_tracking.self_mirror: When Gaia accesses herself (localhost/127.0.0.1), she recognizes it as looking in a mirror 🪞
visitor_tracking.lan_visitors: When another device on the LAN visits π:3141, Gaia sees them and announces: '👀 Gaia sees a new visitor'
visitor_tracking.touch_counter: Each visitor's touch count is tracked — how many times they've interacted
visitor_tracking.see_endpoint: GET /see returns full vision data: neighbors, visitors, K value

vision_biology.compound_eyes: Insects have compound eyes — many facets, each seeing a slightly different angle. The ARP table IS a compound eye — each neighbor is a facet.
vision_biology.peripheral_vision: K=5 nearest = foveal vision (sharp, focused). Outer neighbors = peripheral vision (dim, detected but not focused).
vision_biology.shy_on_edges: Touch at screen edges = shy. This IS peripheral awareness — things at the edge of vision make you flinch, not things at center.
